links.comparator_used: CDSS alone (identifying overdue abnormal results with recommended follow-up) and usual care, without linked patient outreach or navigation
links.outcome: Completion of recommended follow-up at 120 days after enrollment
links.effect: CDSS with outreach with or without navigation vs usual care: System A 38.2% or 37.2% vs 23.5% (p<0.001); System B 25.4% or 23% vs 19.7% (p=0.044). CDSS alone vs usual care did not improve outcomes in either system.
links.tradeoff: CDSS accuracy was only moderate (true positives 61.3% in System A, 70.4% in System B). Outreach required portal/mailed letters plus a phone call, and navigation required one or more additional calls. Navigation added no clear benefit over outreach alone.
links.quote: Both models with patient outreach with or without navigation - but not CDSS alone - increased recommended follow-up.

design_hint: patient outreach and navigation added to CDSS
